test_basic_update_now: test the basic UPDATE_NOW function that updates a single Jam build target immediately
test_ignore_minus_n: test UPDATE_NOW with ignore-minus-n flag to force updates even when dry-run is active
test_failed_target: test UPDATE_NOW behavior when a target fails and dependent targets still need updating
test_missing_target: test UPDATE_NOW error handling when a referenced target has no build rules defined
test_save_restore: test that ignore-minus-n and ignore-minus-q flags are scoped locally to each UPDATE_NOW call
